svg.text: Authorized intervention: actual saved physical response
Eight engineering fixtures / V6 / max step 0.01 s / no policy or field effectiveness claim
A Service after full, residual or aborted work
B Filter response, then actual later inspection
C Compute power changes; offered demand stays
D Backup waits for PLC sample and transfer
Request 3.5 s / sample 4 s / active 6 s
Full deficit 0.9375 s; residual 1.8125 s; aborted 2.25 s. Previous loss is never reset.
Filter 4 -> 2 at 3.25 s; handheld reads at 5.25 s, arrives 5.75 s. Completion alone leaves risk open.
